name: wemember
description: Your company's memory in Claude Code: relevant Wemember context at the first prompt of a session, and optional proposals: your statements as memories, the agent's own findings in a living project document.

propose_memories.title: Propose memories and update the project document during longer sessions
propose_memories.description: Off by default. When on, after every 15 tool calls Claude is asked to propose up to three decisions, preferences or agreements you stated (or picked in a multiple-choice question) to Wemember, and to put its own findings in the project's living document, both personal unless you said yes to your team.
